::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--operations}
Operations Manual
:::

**Owner:** BNR Lead and BNR Analyst.

## Purpose

A data extract is the identified cumulative REDCap export used for one analytical cycle. It records the extract year and month, the extraction time and the source receipt so that results can be reproduced even after REDCap records change.

## Before starting

Confirm that:

- the intended export year and month are unambiguous and the month has ended;
- expected case finding, abstraction and record approval are sufficiently complete;
- REDCap queries and duplicates for the month in question have been resolved;
- known late records and unresolved outcomes have been reviewed;
- REDCap structural changes have been communicated to the analyst; and
- the BNR Lead or delegated role has authorised extraction.

## Step-by-step procedure

1. Record the export year and month and any accepted limitation, such as known late records.
2. Open Stata on the authorised workstation and load the BNR menu if it is not already available.
   - For events, choose **User > BNR > Update CVD events dashboard > Step 1: Extract REDCap data**.
   - For deaths, choose **User > BNR > Update CVD mortality dashboard > Step 1: Extract REDCap data**.
4. Enter the authorised export year and month. Leave replacement (`replace`) off for a first extraction.
5. Select **Run extract**.
6. Confirm that the Stata summary reports `Completed successfully`, the intended period and a plausible record count.
7. Check that the raw CSV, Stata copy and YAML extraction receipt were created in the private release folder, `$BNR_DATA_RAW/redcap/cvd/yYYYY/mMM/`, and that the private log was created under `$BNR_PRIVATE_LOGS/`.
8. Open the receipt and confirm its dates and record count. Stop if they do not match the authorised export.
9. Record that the export is ready for CVD events Step 2.

Later REDCap corrections belong to a subsequent export month, or an explicitly authorised replacement export for the same month. Do not alter the already exported data.

## Stop points

Stop if the reporting period, project, authority, field structure, record count or extraction result is uncertain. Do not use output from a failed or partial Step 1 run.

## Evidence created during extraction

Step 1 automatically creates the following private records for each CVD event release:

- **Raw CSV and Stata source copy:** created in  
  `$BNR_DATA_RAW/redcap/cvd/yYYYY/mMM/`.  
  These are the REDCap data snapshot used for the release.
- **Extraction receipt:** created in the same private release folder as a YAML file.  
  It records the reporting period, extraction details and checks on the source files.
- **Private Stata log:** created under `$BNR_PRIVATE_LOGS/`.  
  It records whether the extraction completed successfully and any error message if it did not.

The release authorisation, reporting period and any accepted limitations should be recorded with the private release records. These files contain private registry information or operational details. Do not copy them into Git or public website folders.
